caption: The drawing depicts a dress design shown from the front and back. The primary focus is on the front view of the dress, which features a fitted bodice colored in green with black horizontal and diagonal stripes. The bodice has an off-the-shoulder neckline and is tightly contoured to the upper body, ending in a pointed waist. The sleeves are short and also green with the same striped pattern. The skirt is long and voluminous, drawn with fine lines and left uncolored, giving it a sense of fullness. To the right of the main figure, there is a smaller outline of the back view of the dress, showing the same off-the-shoulder, fitted bodice and the broad skirt, with lines suggesting lacing or buttons down the center back. The background is plain and uncolored. No facial features, hands, or feet are depicted; the focus is entirely on the dress design.
title: Bodice
